name: Identity Theft and Synthetic Identity
description: Offenders use stolen personal data or blend real and fabricated data to open accounts and credit. Synthetic identities are nurtured over time before large drawdowns, making them hard to link to a real victim.

sources.text: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (specify year, e.g. 2025)

indicators.name: Application data inconsistent across sources
indicators.canon: Inconsistent personal details across documents or sources
indicators.desc: Names, dates of birth, addresses or national ID numbers differ between documents, bureaux or the application.
indicators.ctx: Name, address, date of birth or SSN/national ID disagree across bureaux and documents.
indicators.fp: Data entry errors and recent moves.

indicators.name: Thin or recently created credit file with high requested limits
indicators.canon: Thin or recently created credit file with high requested limits
indicators.desc: Synthetic: little history yet applications seek large lines or multiple facilities.
indicators.ctx: Synthetic: little history yet applications seek large lines or multiple facilities.

indicators.name: Same device or contact data across many applicants
indicators.canon: Shared device, contact or address data across many applicants or senders
indicators.desc: The same device fingerprint, IP, phone, email or address appears across many applications, claims or apparent customers.
indicators.ctx: Shared phone, email or device fingerprint appears across applications with different identities.

indicators.name: Identity document shows tampering or deepfake artefacts
indicators.canon: Identity document tampering or forensic failure
indicators.desc: Identity document or selfie shows alteration, font or layout anomalies, or fails security-feature or forensic checks (including deepfake or injection artefacts).
indicators.ctx: Document or selfie fails forensic checks, shows reuse or injection attack signs.

indicators.name: Address is mail-drop, virtual or shared by many applicants
indicators.canon: Address is mail-drop, virtual or shared by many applicants
indicators.desc: Multiple unrelated applicants share an address with no occupancy history.
indicators.ctx: Multiple unrelated applicants share an address with no occupancy history.

indicators.name: Authorised-user or piggyback tradeline abuse
indicators.desc: Synthetic: new identity added as authorised user to build a credit score.
indicators.ctx: Synthetic: new identity added as authorised user to build a credit score.

indicators.name: Victim reports unknown accounts or credit enquiries
indicators.canon: Victim reports unknown accounts or credit enquiries
indicators.desc: customer discovers accounts opened in their name through alerts or reports.
indicators.ctx: Victim-side: customer discovers accounts opened in their name through alerts or reports.

indicators.name: Bust-out of newly seasoned account
indicators.canon: Sudden credit utilisation spike then bust-out
indicators.desc: Credit builds up and is then rapidly utilised to limit or cashed out after a period of low use.
indicators.ctx: Perpetrator-side: sudden max utilisation and non-payment after months of good conduct.

indicators.name: Rapid account opening across multiple institutions
indicators.canon: Rapid account opening across multiple institutions
indicators.desc: Identity is used for several products in a short window.
indicators.ctx: Identity is used for several products in a short window.
